verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents a hosted official MCP server at https://mcp.agentmail.to/mcp exposing inbox, message, thread, draft, and attachment tools to any compatible client, confirmed by both docs and probe. AgentMail is an email API service (not itself an agent), so serving MCP tools is a legitimate first-party integration axis. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community confirmation that the MCP server works reliably in practice.
